verdict.rationale: Pylon documents grounding mechanisms (Knowledge Base content, custom training data, connectors) and an 'Ask AI' assistant that answers questions from 'your existing data,' plus Support Agents that 'deflect customer questions using content.' However, no evidence explicitly shows answers citing or linking back to the specific source article/document used. Missing for 10: explicit citation/source-attribution UI in Ask AI or Support Agent answers, and independent/hands-on confirmation that grounding actually surfaces source links.
